services.name: Lost Poké Ball collectors
services.location: Outside the nine regular Pokémon Centers
services.description: Speak to the volunteer to collect eligible balls that missed a target. Free; failed captures are different. Excess above bag capacity is held for later.

services.name: Friendship checker
services.description: Complete Side Mission 25. Speak to the person with Roselia. Feedback corresponds to friendship ranges 0; 1–29; 30–79; 80–129; 130–179; 180–219; 220–254; 255.

services.name: EV removal
services.description: Spend five Mega Shards to reset a Pokémon's effort values. The exact story unlock is still to be checked; if unavailable, continue the story.

services.name: Hyper Training
services.description: For level 50 or higher: Bottle Cap for one stat; Gold Bottle Cap for all stats. Hyper Training changes effective stats, not the original underlying IVs. Exact service unlock remains under review.

services.name: IV Judge
services.location: Pokémon Center after the story; then Boxes
services.description: Unlock the Judge at a Pokémon Center; press the right stick in Boxes. Individual IVs: 31 Best, 30 Fantastic, 26–29 Very Good, 16–25 Pretty Good, 1–15 Decent, 0 No Good.

services.name: Plus Move mastery
services.description: Use a Seed of Mastery on an eligible move. Check the available choices in the service menu; not every move is eligible.

services.name: Special Scan
services.description: After Side Mission 188, use 25,000 Hyperspace Survey Points for a special scan. Results are generated; a scan is not a guaranteed particular species or permanent map marker.

services.name: Birthday registration
services.description: After your first Looker Bureau visit, the next clerk may offer registration. The visual celebration details remain to be verified.
